title: 真实 CAN 总线上的完整 OTA 首次实机通过

hardware.adapter: UTC-T01 / PCAN-USB compatible, VID_0C72:000C, PCAN_USBBUS1, 500 kbit/s, baud constant 0x1C
hardware.supply: board power switch ON; ST-Link target voltage 3.24 V; USB_232 enumerated as COM3; CANH/CANL/GND, 120R dip switch
hardware.note: the 22:00 attempt failed because the board power switch was OFF (2.87 V parasitic supply, no CH340); switching it on restored the link without any other change

firmware.loader: build-temp/stage-d-can/loader/loader.bin, 48172 B, sha256 0f14d783e2154d1e..., CAN diagnostics + OTA_ENABLE_FLASHING=1 + STORAGE_TRUSTED=1
firmware.package: build-temp/stage-d/pkgs/app_v24_can.img2, 44920 B, version 24, signed Ed25519, sha256 01c9650129cb6653...
firmware.version_reason: EEPROM metadata had active_version=23 / min_version=23, so 0x37 requires version > 23; a fresh v24 package was generated with make_image.py --version 24 --sign (the prebuilt v14 packages would have been rejected with 7F 37 31)
firmware.signature: independently verified with pure-Python Ed25519 against the demo public key: OK. uds_tool inspect reports signature_verified=false because inspect_package hardcodes that field; the MCU verifies the signature itself.

boot_banner.before_flash: UPDATE-CAPABLE build / update engine ENABLED / installed app failed its CRC or vectors / staying in the loader / loader diagnostics: request 7E0, response 7E8
boot_banner.after_reset: loader: handing off to the app at 08010000 / app at 08010000: awaiting real health checks

transfer.reset_service: 0x11 sent at the end; installation happens in boot_select() after reset
transfer.tester_present: none sent; S3 is an idle timeout and synchronous jobs do not count (uds.c:595/626, stm32_diag.c:38/175)
transfer.watchdog: OTA_ENABLE_WATCHDOG=0 for this build; 18.552 s is well under the previously measured 32.341 s IWDG timeout

installation.payload_match: byte-for-byte equal to app_v24_can.img2 payload (32 B header stripped, 64 B signature stripped)
installation.ticket: installed-ticket.bin, 96 B at 0x080FFFA0: 32 B header byte-equal to package header, 64 B signature byte-equal to package signature ec40408ae63374c6...

status_final.transport_note: read via the UART bench (--backend uart --serial-port COM3) because the application intentionally has no CAN diagnostic endpoint (firmware/app/main.c:22 is a no-op); CAN status timeout after handoff is expected design behaviour, not a failure

boundary.verified: real CAN physical layer + ISO-TP multi-frame + UDS 0x10/0x27/0x34/0x36/0x37/0x31/0x11 + post-reset install + TRIAL confirmation + byte-exact readback + signed ticket
not_verified: power-cut recovery on the real CAN bus (only verified on the UART bench)
fault injection / bus-off recovery under load
long-duration stability and bus load statistics
full OTA from the running application over CAN (this run started from the loader; the App keeps only a UART diagnostic endpoint)
boundary.note: the earlier residual item 'real CAN full OTA' is now closed for the loader-started path; keep the above boundaries when writing resumes
